a: An IP address identifies a host on a network.
DNS maps domain names to IP addresses.
TCP is reliable, ordered, connection-oriented transport.
UDP is connectionless and fast but does not guarantee delivery.
HTTP is the application protocol for web requests and responses.
Ports distinguish services on the same host (e.g. 443 for HTTPS).
A firewall allows or blocks traffic by rules.
Latency is the delay for a packet or request to travel.
Bandwidth is how much data can transfer per unit time.
A CDN caches content closer to users to reduce latency.
